name: nexostock-backend
description: NexoStock services. Each app keeps its own dependencies so Prisma clients do not collide.

scripts.build:libs: npm run build --prefix libs/database && npm run build --prefix libs/common
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --prefix apps/api-gateway && npm run build --prefix apps/auth-service && npm run build --prefix apps/products-service && npm run build --prefix apps/inventory-service && npm run build --prefix apps/sales-service && npm run build --prefix apps/reports-service
